_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description. 'display' overrides the card title (and README label) when the real repo slug is long/ugly - cards.py falls back to the repo's own name if 'display' is omitted. 'repo' MUST match the exact, real slug on github.com/Yash-Gavas/<repo> - cards.py silently skips any entry it can't find, which is what happened to Voyage/NestMatch/DefiHub before this fix.
